readme: Adjudicated canonical (bid,gpu,unit) per conflicted ingredient item, for the 2026-07-26 100%-accuracy reconciliation. update_db=true means the item's db\ingredients.json row ALSO moves (product-accuracy: everyday cost changes too); false means db is already canonical and only the specs converge (synonym/flavor merge, cost ~unchanged). gpu is on the chosen bid's FEED unit. Rice, Sweet Whole Kernel Corn, and Korean glass noodles are handled specially by apply-bid-decisions.ps1 (see notes).
